pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.4: For an explanation of this, see comment at Bu NP 4:2.1.6.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.6: Agāraṁ is typically rendered as “in a house”. The problem with this is that it is not unallowable for a monastic to live in a building that is the equivalent of a house. What a monastic should not do is own a home and then live there.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.12: The six are linen, cotton, silk, wool, sunn hemp, and hemp; see Kd 8:3.1.6. According to Kd 8:21.1.4 this is no smaller than 8 by 4 sugataṅgula, “standard fingerbreadths”. For an explanation of the idea of vikappanā, see Appendix of Technical Terms.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.27: “Fresh food” renders khādanīya. See Appendix of Technical Terms for discussion.
